symbols_en: $R$ is the cavity radius (m); $t$ is time (s), with 0 the chosen initial instant; $R_0$ is its prescribed positive initial value (m); $\dot R$ is wall speed and $U_0$ its initial value (m s⁻¹); $r$ is radial position (m); $u$ is radial liquid speed (m s⁻¹); $p$ is liquid pressure (Pa); $p_\infty$ is prescribed far-field pressure (Pa). The arrow denotes the far-field limit.
symbols_zh: $R$ 为空腔半径（m）；$t$ 为时间（s），0 为选定的初始时刻；$R_0$ 为给定的正初始半径（m）；$\dot R$ 为壁面速度，$U_0$ 为其初值（m s⁻¹）；$r$ 为径向位置（m）；$u$ 为液体径向速度（m s⁻¹）；$p$ 为液体压力（Pa）；$p_\infty$ 为给定远场压力（Pa）。箭头表示远场极限。

notes: Radial direction points from bubble center into carrier
Far-field pressure is an input, not a laser calculation

caption_en: The evolving spherical boundary and the prescribed far-field state.
caption_zh: 运动球形边界与给定的远场状态。

tex: \frac{1}{r^2}\frac{\partial(r^2u)}{\partial r}=0\ \Longrightarrow\ r^2u=C(t),\qquad u(R,t)=\dot R\ \Longrightarrow\ C(t)=R^2\dot R,\qquad u(r,t)=\frac{R^2\dot R}{r^2}
symbols_en: $r\ge R(t)>0$ is radial position (m); $R$ is cavity radius (m); $t$ is time (s); $u$ is radial carrier velocity (m s⁻¹); $\dot R$ is wall speed (m s⁻¹); $C(t)$ is the radius-independent flux factor (m³ s⁻¹), not a material constant; $\partial/\partial r$ differentiates at fixed time. The implication arrows indicate integration and use of the interface condition.
symbols_zh: $r\ge R(t)>0$ 为径向位置（m）；$R$ 为空腔半径（m）；$t$ 为时间（s）；$u$ 为载液径向速度（m s⁻¹）；$\dot R$ 为壁面速度（m s⁻¹）；$C(t)$ 为与径向位置无关的流量因子（m³ s⁻¹），并非材料常数；$\partial/\partial r$ 表示固定时间下的径向求导。箭头表示积分及应用界面条件。
kind: Exact continuity within the spherical model

notes: Concentric surfaces carry the same volume flux
At r = 2R the speed is Ṙ/4

caption_en: Inverse-square velocity decay places the inertia in the surrounding carrier.
caption_zh: 速度按距离平方反比衰减，惯性来自周围载液。

symbols_en: $\phi$ is velocity potential (m² s⁻¹); $r$ is liquid radial position and $R$ cavity radius (m); $t$ is time (s); $s$ is a dummy radial integration coordinate (m); $u$ is radial velocity (m s⁻¹); $\dot R$ is wall speed (m s⁻¹); the integral is an improper integral convergent for $r\ge R>0$; $\partial/\partial r$ is the fixed-time spatial derivative.
symbols_zh: $\phi$ 为速度势（m² s⁻¹）；$r$ 为液体径向位置，$R$ 为空腔半径（m）；$t$ 为时间（s）；$s$ 为径向积分哑变量（m）；$u$ 为径向速度（m s⁻¹）；$\dot R$ 为壁面速度（m s⁻¹）；该广义积分在 $r\ge R>0$ 时收敛；$\partial/\partial r$ 为固定时间的空间导数。

notes: Differentiate spatially to recover the radial flow

caption_en: The potential reference is fixed at infinity before differentiation.
caption_zh: 在求导之前，先固定无穷远处的速度势参考值。

tex: \left.\frac{\partial\phi}{\partial t}\right|_r=-\frac{2R\dot R^2+R^2\ddot R}{r},\qquad \left.\frac{\partial\phi}{\partial t}\right|_{r=R}=-(2\dot R^2+R\ddot R),\qquad \frac{d\phi(R(t),t)}{dt}=-\dot R^2-R\ddot R
symbols_en: $\phi$ is velocity potential (m² s⁻¹); $t$ is time (s); $r$ is fixed radial position, $R(t)>0$ is moving cavity radius (m); $\dot R$ and $\ddot R$ are wall speed (m s⁻¹) and acceleration (m s⁻²); vertical bars specify where the derivative is taken or evaluated; $d/dt$ follows the moving wall value. Each derivative has units m² s⁻².
symbols_zh: $\phi$ 为速度势（m² s⁻¹）；$t$ 为时间（s）；$r$ 为固定径向位置，$R(t)>0$ 为运动空腔半径（m）；$\dot R$ 与 $\ddot R$ 分别为壁面速度（m s⁻¹）和加速度（m s⁻²）；竖线表示求导或取值条件；$d/dt$ 跟随运动壁面的取值。各导数的单位均为 m² s⁻²。

notes: Take the partial derivative before setting r = R
The moving-point derivative differs by Ṙ²

caption_en: A fixed liquid observation point and a moving interface point have different time derivatives.
caption_zh: 固定液体观察点与运动界面点对应不同的时间导数。

tex: \frac{p_l-p_\infty}{\rho}=-\left.\frac{\partial\phi}{\partial t}\right|_{r=R}-\frac{u(R,t)^2}{2}=2\dot R^2+R\ddot R-\frac{\dot R^2}{2}=R\ddot R+\frac32\dot R^2
symbols_en: $p_l$ is liquid pressure at the wall and $p_\infty$ far-field pressure (Pa); $\rho>0$ is carrier density (kg m⁻³); $\phi$ is velocity potential (m² s⁻¹); $t$ is time (s); $r$ is radial position and $R>0$ cavity radius (m); $u$ is radial velocity and $\dot R$ wall speed (m s⁻¹); $\ddot R$ is wall acceleration (m s⁻²); $\partial_t$ is taken at fixed position before wall evaluation.
symbols_zh: $p_l$ 为壁面液体压力，$p_\infty$ 为远场压力（Pa）；$\rho>0$ 为载液密度（kg m⁻³）；$\phi$ 为速度势（m² s⁻¹）；$t$ 为时间（s）；$r$ 为径向位置，$R>0$ 为空腔半径（m）；$u$ 为径向速度，$\dot R$ 为壁面速度（m s⁻¹）；$\ddot R$ 为壁面加速度（m s⁻²）；$\partial_t$ 必须先在固定位置求导，再于壁面取值。

notes: R R̈ and 3Ṙ²/2 each have units m²/s²

caption_en: Liquid inertia relates the interface pressure to wall acceleration and squared speed.
caption_zh: 液体惯性把界面压力与壁面加速度及速度平方联系起来。

tex: \left.\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}\right|_{r=R}=\left.-\frac{2R^2\dot R}{r^3}\right|_{r=R}=-\frac{2\dot R}{R},\qquad p_l=p_b-\frac{2\sigma}{R}+2\mu\left.\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}\right|_{r=R}=p_b-\frac{2\sigma}{R}-\frac{4\mu\dot R}{R}
symbols_en: $u$ is radial velocity and $\dot R$ wall speed (m s⁻¹); $r$ is radial position and $R>0$ cavity radius (m); $p_l,p_b$ are liquid-side and uniform bubble pressures (Pa); $\sigma\ge0$ is surface tension (N m⁻¹); $\mu\ge0$ is carrier viscosity (Pa s); $\partial_r u$ is radial strain rate (s⁻¹); wall evaluation is performed at $r=R$.
symbols_zh: $u$ 为径向速度，$\dot R$ 为壁面速度（m s⁻¹）；$r$ 为径向位置，$R>0$ 为空腔半径（m）；$p_l,p_b$ 分别为液体侧与空间均匀的气泡压力（Pa）；$\sigma\ge0$ 为表面张力（N m⁻¹）；$\mu\ge0$ 为载液黏度（Pa s）；$\partial_r u$ 为径向应变率（s⁻¹）；壁面取值在 $r=R$ 处进行。
kind: Newtonian stress and capillary boundary condition

notes: Viscous stress changes sign when the wall reverses

caption_en: Capillary and viscous stresses act at the interface even when the radial bulk viscous force is zero.
caption_zh: 即使径向体内黏性力为零，毛细与黏性应力仍作用于界面。

symbols_en: $\rho>0$ is carrier density (kg m⁻³); $R>0$ is cavity radius (m); $\dot R,\ddot R$ are wall speed (m s⁻¹) and acceleration (m s⁻²); $p_b,p_\infty$ are bubble and far-field pressures (Pa); $\sigma$ is constant surface tension (N m⁻¹); $\mu$ is constant carrier viscosity (Pa s). Every term is a pressure.
symbols_zh: $\rho>0$ 为载液密度（kg m⁻³）；$R>0$ 为空腔半径（m）；$\dot R,\ddot R$ 分别为壁面速度（m s⁻¹）和加速度（m s⁻²）；$p_b,p_\infty$ 为气泡与远场压力（Pa）；$\sigma$ 为常数表面张力（N m⁻¹）；$\mu$ 为常数载液黏度（Pa s）。各项均具有压力单位。

notes: Outward is positive
The equation predicts radius, not jet shape

caption_en: The spherical pressure–inertia balance has a scalar radial state.
caption_zh: 球形压力—惯性平衡只具有标量径向状态。

symbols_en: $p_b$ is uniform total bubble pressure (Pa); $p_{v,\mathrm{PFC}}$ is the PFC-vapor partial pressure, $p_{v,w}$ water-vapor partial pressure, and $p_g$ permanent-gas partial pressure (all Pa). Subscript $v$ labels vapor, PFC its chemical family, $w$ water, and $g$ noncondensable gas. Additivity assumes a gas-mixture pressure description with the stated partial pressures.
symbols_zh: $p_b$ 为空间均匀的气泡总压力（Pa）；$p_{v,\mathrm{PFC}}$ 为 PFC 蒸气分压，$p_{v,w}$ 为水蒸气分压，$p_g$ 为非凝结气体分压（均为 Pa）。下标 $v$ 表示蒸气，PFC 表示该化学物质族，$w$ 表示水，$g$ 表示非凝结气体。相加关系采用具有上述分压定义的气体混合物压力描述。

notes: Partial pressures need mass and energy histories
No fixed-mass gas law is automatically a vaporization law

caption_en: The mechanical input comes from the evolving contents, not from radius alone.
caption_zh: 力学输入来自不断变化的气泡内容物，不能仅由半径决定。

tex: \begin{aligned}K_l&=\int_R^\infty\frac12\rho u(r,t)^2\,4\pi r^2\,dr\\&=2\pi\rho R^4\dot R^2\int_R^\infty r^{-2}\,dr\\&=2\pi\rho R^4\dot R^2\left[-\frac1r\right]_R^\infty=2\pi\rho R^3\dot R^2.\end{aligned}
symbols_en: $K_l$ is exterior liquid kinetic energy (J); $\rho$ is carrier density (kg m⁻³); $u$ is radial liquid speed and $\dot R$ wall speed (m s⁻¹); $t$ is time (s); $R>0$ is cavity radius, $r$ the integration radius (m); $\pi$ is the circle constant; $4\pi r^2dr$ is the spherical volume element (m³); endpoint brackets mean upper minus lower evaluation.
symbols_zh: $K_l$ 为外部液体动能（J）；$\rho$ 为载液密度（kg m⁻³）；$u$ 为径向液体速度，$\dot R$ 为壁面速度（m s⁻¹）；$t$ 为时间（s）；$R>0$ 为空腔半径，$r$ 为积分半径（m）；$\pi$ 为圆周率；$4\pi r^2dr$ 为球形体积元（m³）；端点方括号表示上限取值减下限取值。
kind: Exact kinetic-energy integral in the spherical model

notes: Integrate liquid shells outside the cavity
The radial field decays enough for finite kinetic energy

caption_en: Exterior shells contribute finite kinetic energy even in an infinite domain.
caption_zh: 即使外域无限，外部液壳贡献的总动能仍有限。

tex: \begin{aligned}\frac{dK_l}{dt}&=2\pi\rho\left(3R^2\dot R^3+2R^3\dot R\ddot R\right)=4\pi R^2\dot R\,\rho\left(R\ddot R+\frac32\dot R^2\right),\\V_b&=\frac{4\pi R^3}{3},\qquad \dot V_b=4\pi R^2\dot R,\\E_\sigma&=4\pi\sigma R^2,\qquad \frac{dE_\sigma}{dt}=8\pi\sigma R\dot R.\end{aligned}
symbols_en: $K_l,E_\sigma$ are liquid kinetic and interface energies (J); $t$ is time (s); $\rho$ is carrier density (kg m⁻³); $R$ is radius (m); $\dot R,\ddot R$ are speed (m s⁻¹) and acceleration (m s⁻²); $V_b$ is cavity volume (m³), $\dot V_b$ its time derivative (m³ s⁻¹); $\sigma$ is constant surface tension (N m⁻¹); $\pi$ is the circle constant. Energy derivatives are powers (W).
symbols_zh: $K_l,E_\sigma$ 分别为液体动能与界面能（J）；$t$ 为时间（s）；$\rho$ 为载液密度（kg m⁻³）；$R$ 为半径（m）；$\dot R,\ddot R$ 分别为速度（m s⁻¹）与加速度（m s⁻²）；$V_b$ 为空腔体积（m³），$\dot V_b$ 为其时间导数（m³ s⁻¹）；$\sigma$ 为常数表面张力（N m⁻¹）；$\pi$ 为圆周率。能量的时间导数为功率（W）。

notes: Surface energy is stored at the spherical boundary
Volume work changes both liquid speed and effective inertia

caption_en: Volume work couples kinetic storage, interface storage and dissipation.
caption_zh: 体积功耦合动能储存、界面能储存与耗散。

symbols_en: $t$ is time (s); $K_l,E_\sigma$ are kinetic and interface energies (J); $p_b,p_\infty$ are bubble and far-field pressures (Pa); $\dot V_b$ is cavity volume rate (m³ s⁻¹); $\mu\ge0$ is carrier viscosity (Pa s); $R>0$ is cavity radius (m); $\dot R$ is wall speed (m s⁻¹); $\pi$ is the circle constant. The nonnegative term is dissipated power (W).
symbols_zh: $t$ 为时间（s）；$K_l,E_\sigma$ 为动能与界面能（J）；$p_b,p_\infty$ 为气泡与远场压力（Pa）；$\dot V_b$ 为空腔体积变化率（m³ s⁻¹）；$\mu\ge0$ 为载液黏度（Pa s）；$R>0$ 为空腔半径（m）；$\dot R$ 为壁面速度（m s⁻¹）；$\pi$ 为圆周率。非负项是耗散功率（W）。

notes: Expansion or collapse may supply positive pressure work
Viscosity always removes mechanical energy

caption_en: The pressure source supplies mechanical work; focusing cannot create extra energy.
caption_zh: 压力源提供机械功；聚焦不能产生额外能量。

tex: \begin{aligned}D_{rr}&=-\frac{2R^2\dot R}{r^3},\qquad D_{\theta\theta}=D_{\psi\psi}=\frac{R^2\dot R}{r^3},\\\mathcal D_\mu&=\int_R^\infty 2\mu\left(D_{rr}^2+D_{\theta\theta}^2+D_{\psi\psi}^2\right)4\pi r^2\,dr\\&=48\pi\mu R^4\dot R^2\int_R^\infty r^{-4}\,dr=16\pi\mu R\dot R^2.\end{aligned}
symbols_en: $D_{rr},D_{\theta\theta},D_{\psi\psi}$ are radial and two tangential strain-rate components (s⁻¹), with $r,\theta,\psi$ labeling spherical radial, polar and azimuthal directions; $\mathcal D_\mu$ is total viscous dissipation rate (W); $\mu$ is viscosity (Pa s); $R>0$ is radius and $r$ radial integration position (m); $\dot R$ is wall speed (m s⁻¹); $\pi$ is the circle constant. The integral is over the liquid exterior; angular labels do not reuse the potential symbol $\phi$.
symbols_zh: $D_{rr},D_{\theta\theta},D_{\psi\psi}$ 为径向与两个切向的应变率分量（s⁻¹），其中 $r,\theta,\psi$ 分别表示球坐标径向、极角与方位角方向；$\mathcal D_\mu$ 为总黏性耗散率（W）；$\mu$ 为黏度（Pa s）；$R>0$ 为半径，$r$ 为径向积分位置（m）；$\dot R$ 为壁面速度（m s⁻¹）；$\pi$ 为圆周率。积分区域为液体外域；角向标记不复用速度势符号 $\phi$。

notes: Integrate the positive dissipation density in exterior shells

caption_en: Direct strain-rate integration verifies the mechanical-energy loss.
caption_zh: 直接积分应变率检验机械能损失。

tex: \Delta p_c=p_\infty-p_v>0,\qquad R(0)=R_{\max},\quad \dot R(0)=0,\qquad R\ddot R+\frac32\dot R^2=-\frac{\Delta p_c}{\rho}
symbols_en: $\Delta p_c>0$ is constant collapse-driving pressure (Pa); $p_\infty,p_v$ are constant far-field and vapor pressures (Pa); $t=0$ is maximum-radius time (s); $R>0$ and $R_{\max}>0$ are instantaneous and maximum radii (m); $\dot R,\ddot R$ are speed (m s⁻¹) and acceleration (m s⁻²); $\rho>0$ is carrier density (kg m⁻³).
symbols_zh: $\Delta p_c>0$ 为常数塌缩驱动压差（Pa）；$p_\infty,p_v$ 为常数远场压力与蒸气压（Pa）；$t=0$ 为最大半径时刻（s）；$R>0$ 与 $R_{\max}>0$ 分别为当前与最大半径（m）；$\dot R,\ddot R$ 为速度（m s⁻¹）与加速度（m s⁻²）；$\rho>0$ 为载液密度（kg m⁻³）。

notes: Constant pressure deficit initiates inward acceleration

caption_en: The ideal control begins at rest and excludes the mechanisms that arrest real collapse.
caption_zh: 理想对照从静止开始，并排除了阻止实际塌缩的机制。

tex: \begin{aligned}y(R)&=\dot R^2,\qquad \frac{dy}{dt}=\frac{dy}{dR}\dot R=2\dot R\ddot R\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\ddot R=\frac12\frac{dy}{dR},\\\frac{dy}{dR}+\frac{3y}{R}&=-\frac{2\Delta p_c}{\rho R},\\\frac{d(R^3y)}{dR}&=R^3\frac{dy}{dR}+3R^2y=-\frac{2\Delta p_c}{\rho}R^2.\end{aligned}
symbols_en: $y(R)$ is squared wall speed (m² s⁻²); $R\in(0,R_{\max})$ is decreasing radius (m); $t$ is time (s); $\dot R\ne0$ and $\ddot R$ are speed (m s⁻¹) and acceleration (m s⁻²); $\Delta p_c$ is positive pressure difference (Pa); $\rho$ is carrier density (kg m⁻³); $d/dR$ and $d/dt$ are ordinary derivatives on the monotonic branch. Radius powers are the integrating factor, not derivatives.
symbols_zh: $y(R)$ 为壁面速度平方（m² s⁻²）；$R\in(0,R_{\max})$ 为递减半径（m）；$t$ 为时间（s）；$\dot R\ne0$ 与 $\ddot R$ 为速度（m s⁻¹）与加速度（m s⁻²）；$\Delta p_c$ 为正压差（Pa）；$\rho$ 为载液密度（kg m⁻³）；$d/dR$ 与 $d/dt$ 为单调分支上的普通导数。半径幂构成积分因子，并非导数。
kind: Exact chain rule and integrating factor

notes: Cancel speed only away from the initial turning point

caption_en: The monotonic collapse branch allows radius to replace time in the first integration.
caption_zh: 单调塌缩分支允许在第一次积分中以半径取代时间。

symbols_en: $R\in(0,R_{\max}]$ and $R_{\max}$ are current and maximum radii (m); $y$ is squared speed (m² s⁻²); $s$ is dummy radius (m); $\Delta p_c>0$ is collapse pressure (Pa); $\rho>0$ is carrier density (kg m⁻³); $\dot R\le0$ is inward wall velocity (m s⁻¹). The square root denotes the nonnegative root; its prefixed minus sign selects collapse.
symbols_zh: $R\in(0,R_{\max}]$ 与 $R_{\max}$ 分别为当前与最大半径（m）；$y$ 为速度平方（m² s⁻²）；$s$ 为积分哑半径（m）；$\Delta p_c>0$ 为塌缩压差（Pa）；$\rho>0$ 为载液密度（kg m⁻³）；$\dot R\le0$ 为向内壁面速度（m s⁻¹）。根号表示非负平方根；前置负号选择塌缩分支。
kind: Integrated speed with initial constant and branch

notes: Speed is zero at R = Rmax
Zero radius is an excluded model endpoint

caption_en: The initial condition fixes the integration constant and the inward sign fixes the branch.
caption_zh: 初值确定积分常数，向内的符号确定解分支。

symbols_en: $t_c$ is ideal collapse time (s); $R$ is radius and $R_{\max}$ its maximum (m); $\dot R<0$ is inward velocity (m s⁻¹); $\rho$ is density (kg m⁻³); $\Delta p_c>0$ is pressure difference (Pa); $x=R/R_{\max}\in[0,1]$ is dimensionless radius; $C_t$ is the dimensionless time coefficient; definite integrals follow the collapse branch. $dx$ and $dR$ denote integration measures.
symbols_zh: $t_c$ 为理想塌缩时间（s）；$R$ 为半径，$R_{\max}$ 为其最大值（m）；$\dot R<0$ 为向内速度（m s⁻¹）；$\rho$ 为密度（kg m⁻³）；$\Delta p_c>0$ 为压差（Pa）；$x=R/R_{\max}\in[0,1]$ 为无量纲半径；$C_t$ 为无量纲时间系数；定积分沿塌缩分支进行。$dx$ 与 $dR$ 表示积分测度。

notes: At x = 0 the integrand behaves as x³ᐟ²
At x = 1 it behaves as (1 − x)⁻¹ᐟ²

caption_en: The endpoint singularity is integrable, so the model has a finite collapse time.
caption_zh: 端点奇异性可积，因此该模型具有有限塌缩时间。

symbols_en: $x$ and $q=x^3$ are dimensionless radius and substitution variables on [0,1]; $C_t$ is the dimensionless collapse-time coefficient; $B(a,b)$ is the beta function, defined by the displayed convergent integral; $a,b$ are positive dimensionless arguments; $dx,dq$ are integration measures. The numeral 6 inside the root is a dimensionless constant; the ellipsis indicates decimal continuation.
symbols_zh: $x$ 与 $q=x^3$ 分别为区间 [0,1] 上的无量纲半径与换元变量；$C_t$ 为无量纲塌缩时间系数；$B(a,b)$ 为贝塔函数，由公式中的收敛积分定义；$a,b$ 为正的无量纲参数；$dx,dq$ 为积分测度。根号中的数字 6 为无量纲常数；省略号表示后续小数。

notes: The coefficient comes from the complete radius trajectory, not a material fit

caption_en: The change of variables exposes the beta integral that fixes the numerical coefficient.
caption_zh: 换元揭示贝塔积分，从而确定数值系数。

symbols_en: $K_l$ is carrier kinetic energy, $E_B$ the maximum-volume pressure-work scale (J); $R\in(0,R_{\max}]$ and $R_{\max}$ are radii (m); $\rho$ is density (kg m⁻³); $\Delta p_c$ is constant positive pressure difference (Pa); $V_{\max}$ is maximum cavity volume (m³); $\pi$ is the circle constant. $K_l/E_B$ is dimensionless and this control has zero viscous and capillary losses.
symbols_zh: $K_l$ 为载液动能，$E_B$ 为最大体积的压力功尺度（J）；$R\in(0,R_{\max}]$ 与 $R_{\max}$ 为半径（m）；$\rho$ 为密度（kg m⁻³）；$\Delta p_c$ 为常数正压差（Pa）；$V_{\max}$ 为最大空腔体积（m³）；$\pi$ 为圆周率。$K_l/E_B$ 无量纲，此对照模型的黏性与毛细损失为零。

notes: Finite energy survives the excluded zero-radius speed singularity

caption_en: The Rayleigh speed solution and pressure-work balance agree exactly.
caption_zh: 瑞利速度解与压力功平衡严格一致。

Optical pulse duration is not automatically whole-core heating duration

caption_zh: 应比较热渗透尺度与到达 PFC 的距离，而不只是光束宽度。

caption_zh: 界面张力相同时，较小夹杂的毛细压力贡献更大。

symbols_zh: $p_{\mathrm{sat,PFP}}(T)$ 为体相平衡 PFP 蒸汽压（Pa），sat 表示饱和；$T$ 为所给范围内的绝对温度（K）；$\log_{10}$ 为常用对数。一巴等于 $10^5$ Pa。经验系数 4.2063 无量纲；1103.454 K 和 39.77 K 具有温度单位。所给范围内分母为正。

notes: Liquid and vapor coexist only when inventory and exchange permit
This curve is not a laser-fluence threshold

caption_zh: 饱和曲线描述平衡状态，而不是自动激活。

notes: Use the coefficient branch belonging to the temperature
The hot PFC and carrier may have different local temperatures

caption_zh: 水提供同温参照，却不是有保证的蒸汽库。

symbols_zh: $\Delta p_n$ 为汽化成核驱动压差（Pa），n 表示成核；$p_{\mathrm{sat,PFC}}(T_i)$ 为局部界面温度 $T_i$ 下的体相 PFC 饱和蒸汽压（Pa 和 K）；$p_d$ 为 PFC 液体压力（Pa）；$W(r_n)$ 为汽核形成自由能（J）；$r_n\ge0$ 为汽核半径（m）；$\sigma_{vp}>0$ 为蒸汽–PFC 张力（N m⁻¹），vp 表示该界面；$\pi$ 为圆周率。模型假设 $T_i,p_d$ 固定，且 $r_n$ 远小于 PFC 核心。

notes: The outer PFC–carrier tension is a different interface
The whole core cannot be treated as an infinite liquid reservoir

caption_en: The barrier belongs to creating a new internal vapor interface.
caption_zh: 势垒来自生成新的内部蒸汽界面。

caption_zh: 该驻点是最大值，不是稳定平衡汽核。

A positive driving pressure still leaves a finite barrier

caption_en: Positive superheat driving does not make the nucleation barrier vanish.
caption_zh: 正的过热驱动力并不会使成核势垒消失。

caption_zh: 激活概率需要速率及处于可激活状态的时长。

caption_zh: 化合物账目在膨胀、凝结、溶解及排气过程中均成立。

symbols_en: $m_{v,s}$ is vapor mass of species $s$ (kg), where $s$ labels a specified species such as PFC or water; a dot is a time derivative (kg s⁻¹); the phase label isolates the phase-change contribution, excluding escape and dissolution; $j_s$ is signed liquid-to-vapor mass flux (kg m⁻² s⁻¹); $\Gamma_s$ is the species-contacting interface; $dA$ is its area element (m²); $R>0$ is spherical interface radius (m) only in the special second formula; $\pi$ is the circular constant; $\int$ is surface integration.
symbols_zh: $m_{v,s}$ 为组分 $s$ 的蒸汽质量（kg），$s$ 标记 PFC 或水等明确组分；上点表示时间导数（kg s⁻¹）；phase 标记单独的相变贡献，不含逸出与溶解；$j_s$ 为带符号液到汽质量通量（kg m⁻² s⁻¹）；$\Gamma_s$ 为该组分接触的界面；$dA$ 为面积元（m²）；$R>0$ 仅在第二个特殊式中表示球形界面半径（m）；$\pi$ 为圆周率；$\int$ 为面积积分。

labels: m_v,s, ṁ_v,s: vapor inventory and rate
R: complete bubble radius only when applicable
notes: PFC may occupy only a residual inclusion
Do not give every species the whole bubble area automatically

caption_en: A bubble surface and a PFC evaporation surface need not be identical.
caption_zh: 气泡表面与 PFC 蒸发表面未必相同。

tex: \begin{aligned}j_s&=\rho_l(\boldsymbol u_l-\boldsymbol v_\Gamma)\cdot\boldsymbol n=\rho_v(\boldsymbol u_v-\boldsymbol v_\Gamma)\cdot\boldsymbol n,\\\boldsymbol n&=-\boldsymbol e_r,\quad\boldsymbol v_\Gamma=\dot R\boldsymbol e_r,\quad j_s=\rho_l[\dot R-u_l(R)],\\u_l(R)&=\dot R-j_s/\rho_l.\end{aligned}
symbols_en: $j_s$ is single-component phase mass flux (kg m⁻² s⁻¹), s labeling that component; $\rho_l,\rho_v>0$ are adjacent liquid and vapor densities (kg m⁻³); $\boldsymbol u_l,\boldsymbol u_v$ are their velocities (m s⁻¹); $\boldsymbol v_\Gamma$ is interface velocity (m s⁻¹); $\boldsymbol n$ is unit normal liquid→vapor and $\boldsymbol e_r$ outward radial unit vector (dimensionless); $R>0$ is bubble radius (m), $\dot R$ its time derivative (m s⁻¹); $u_l(R)$ is outward radial liquid velocity at the interface (m s⁻¹); $\cdot$ is a vector dot product.
symbols_zh: $j_s$ 为单组分相变质量通量（kg m⁻² s⁻¹），s 标记该组分；$\rho_l,\rho_v>0$ 为邻接液体与蒸汽密度（kg m⁻³）；$\boldsymbol u_l,\boldsymbol u_v$ 为两侧速度（m s⁻¹）；$\boldsymbol v_\Gamma$ 为界面速度（m s⁻¹）；$\boldsymbol n$ 为液→汽单位法向，$\boldsymbol e_r$ 为向外径向单位向量（无量纲）；$R>0$ 为气泡半径（m），$\dot R$ 为其时间导数（m s⁻¹）；$u_l(R)$ 为界面处向外径向液速（m s⁻¹）；$\cdot$ 为向量点积。

notes: Positive j_s makes liquid speed smaller than outward wall speed
For mixtures, species diffusion augments the component fluxes

caption_en: The interface need not move at the same speed as the adjacent liquid.
caption_zh: 界面不必以邻接液体的速度运动。

tex: L_{v,s}=h_{v,s}-h_{l,s}>0,\qquad j_sL_{v,s}=(\boldsymbol q_l-\boldsymbol q_v)\cdot\boldsymbol n,\qquad\boldsymbol q_\eta=-k_\eta\nabla T_\eta\quad(\eta=l,v)
symbols_en: $L_{v,s}>0$ is latent enthalpy per species mass (J kg⁻¹); $h_{v,s},h_{l,s}$ are vapor and liquid specific enthalpies of species s at the interface (J kg⁻¹); $j_s$ is signed evaporation flux (kg m⁻² s⁻¹); $\boldsymbol q_l,\boldsymbol q_v$ are conductive heat fluxes on liquid and vapor sides (W m⁻²); $\boldsymbol n$ points liquid→vapor; $\eta\in\{l,v\}$ labels phase; $k_\eta$ and $T_\eta$ are conductivity (W m⁻¹ K⁻¹) and temperature (K); $\nabla$ is spatial gradient (m⁻¹); $\cdot$ is a vector dot product. All terms in the heat jump have units W m⁻².
symbols_zh: $L_{v,s}>0$ 为单位组分质量的潜焓（J kg⁻¹）；$h_{v,s},h_{l,s}$ 为界面处组分 s 的蒸汽与液体比焓（J kg⁻¹）；$j_s$ 为带符号蒸发通量（kg m⁻² s⁻¹）；$\boldsymbol q_l,\boldsymbol q_v$ 为液、汽两侧传导热通量（W m⁻²）；$\boldsymbol n$ 从液指向汽；$\eta\in\{l,v\}$ 表示相；$k_\eta,T_\eta$ 为导热系数（W m⁻¹ K⁻¹）与温度（K）；$\nabla$ 为空间梯度（m⁻¹）；$\cdot$ 为向量点积。热跳跃式各项单位均为 W m⁻²。
kind: Reduced interfacial energy jump and Fourier law

labels: k_l, k_v; T_l, T_v: thermal fields
η = l or v; ∇: local gradient
notes: Evaporation j_s > 0 consumes latent enthalpy
Condensation j_s < 0 supplies heat to surrounding material

caption_en: The liquid-to-vapor normal fixes the signs of heat and phase flux.
caption_zh: 液到汽法向确定热通量及相变通量符号。

tex: \dot U_b=\dot Q_b-p_b\dot V_b+\sum_{s=1}^{N_s}h_{v,s}\dot m_{v,s},\qquad V_b=\frac{4\pi}{3}R^3,\qquad\dot V_b=4\pi R^2\dot R
symbols_en: $U_b$ is bubble internal energy (J); $\dot Q_b$ is net conductive heat into the bubble (W), excluding transported mass enthalpy; $p_b$ is uniform absolute bubble pressure (Pa); $V_b$ is bubble volume (m³); $R>0$ is radius in the spherical control (m); $h_{v,s}$ is boundary specific vapor enthalpy of species s (J kg⁻¹); $\dot m_{v,s}$ is its signed net mass-entry rate (kg s⁻¹); $s=1,\ldots,N_s$ indexes the $N_s$ species, a dimensionless count; $\sum$ is summation; a dot is a time derivative, and $\pi$ is the circular constant. Distinct entry/exit states require distinct summed boundary terms.
symbols_zh: $U_b$ 为气泡内能（J）；$\dot Q_b$ 为进入气泡的净传导热（W），不含随质量输运的焓；$p_b$ 为均匀绝对气泡压力（Pa）；$V_b$ 为气泡体积（m³）；$R>0$ 为球形参照的半径（m）；$h_{v,s}$ 为组分 s 的边界蒸汽比焓（J kg⁻¹）；$\dot m_{v,s}$ 为其带符号净流入质量速率（kg s⁻¹）；$s=1,\ldots,N_s$ 遍历 $N_s$ 个组分，$N_s$ 为无量纲数量；$\sum$ 为求和；上点为时间导数，$\pi$ 为圆周率。不同流入／流出状态要求分别求和其边界项。

labels: R, Ṙ: bubble geometry and speed
notes: Expansion removes energy through p_b V̇_b
Do not add a second latent-heat source to transported vapor enthalpy

caption_en: Mass enthalpy and conductive heat are different terms in the bubble ledger.
caption_zh: 质量焓与传导热是气泡账目中的不同项。

tex: \begin{aligned}U_b&=\sum_{s=1}^{N_s}m_{v,s}e_s(T_b),\qquad c_{v,s}=de_s/dT_b,\\\dot U_b&=\left(\sum_s m_{v,s}c_{v,s}\right)\dot T_b+\sum_s e_s\dot m_{v,s},\\\left(\sum_s m_{v,s}c_{v,s}\right)\dot T_b&=\dot Q_b-p_b\dot V_b+\sum_s(h_{v,s}-e_s)\dot m_{v,s}.\end{aligned}
symbols_en: $U_b$ is internal energy (J); $m_{v,s}$ is species vapor mass (kg); $e_s(T_b)$ is specific internal energy using a consistent reference (J kg⁻¹); $T_b$ is common bubble temperature (K); $c_{v,s}=de_s/dT_b$ is constant-volume specific heat (J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹); $h_{v,s}$ is actual boundary specific enthalpy (J kg⁻¹); $\dot Q_b$ is conductive heat input (W); $p_b,V_b$ are pressure (Pa) and volume (m³); $s=1,\ldots,N_s$ is species index and $\sum_s$ sums that range; a dot denotes a time derivative; $d/dT_b$ is temperature differentiation. Boundary temperature may differ from $T_b$ and must then be used in $h_{v,s}$.
symbols_zh: $U_b$ 为内能（J）；$m_{v,s}$ 为组分蒸汽质量（kg）；$e_s(T_b)$ 为采用一致参考的比内能（J kg⁻¹）；$T_b$ 为共同气泡温度（K）；$c_{v,s}=de_s/dT_b$ 为定容比热（J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹）；$h_{v,s}$ 为实际边界比焓（J kg⁻¹）；$\dot Q_b$ 为传导热输入（W）；$p_b,V_b$ 为压力（Pa）与体积（m³）；$s=1,\ldots,N_s$ 为组分指标，$\sum_s$ 对该范围求和；上点表示时间导数；$d/dT_b$ 为温度求导。边界温度可不同于 $T_b$，此时 $h_{v,s}$ 必须使用边界温度。

notes: The product rule includes both temperature and mass changes
Consistent energy references preserve the balance

caption_en: A variable vapor mass makes a fixed-mass polytropic shortcut conditional.
caption_zh: 蒸汽质量变化，使固定质量多方捷径只能有条件成立。

tex: p_{v,s}V_b=\frac{m_{v,s}}{M_s}R_uT_b,\qquad p_b=\sum_{s=1}^{N_s}p_{v,s},\qquad p_b=\mathcal P(\rho_b,e_b,\boldsymbol Y)\quad\text{for a stated real-mixture EOS}
symbols_en: $p_{v,s}$ is ideal partial pressure of species s (Pa), v naming the vapor-domain component; $V_b>0$ is bubble volume (m³); $m_{v,s}\ge0$ is its mass (kg); $M_s>0$ is molar mass (kg mol⁻¹); $R_u=8.314462618$ J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ is the universal gas constant; $T_b>0$ is bulk temperature (K); $p_b$ is total pressure (Pa); $s=1,\ldots,N_s$ indexes all components including permanent gas; $\sum$ is summation. $\mathcal P$ is a specified equation-of-state function, $\rho_b$ mixture density (kg m⁻³), $e_b$ specific internal energy (J kg⁻¹), and $\boldsymbol Y$ the species mass-fraction vector (dimensionless, entries summing to one); EOS means equation of state.
symbols_zh: $p_{v,s}$ 为组分 s 的理想分压（Pa），v 标记蒸汽域组分；$V_b>0$ 为气泡体积（m³）；$m_{v,s}\ge0$ 为其质量（kg）；$M_s>0$ 为摩尔质量（kg mol⁻¹）；$R_u=8.314462618$ J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ 为通用气体常数；$T_b>0$ 为体相温度（K）；$p_b$ 为总压力（Pa）；$s=1,\ldots,N_s$ 遍历包含永久气体的所有组分；$\sum$ 为求和。$\mathcal P$ 为明确的状态方程函数，$\rho_b$ 为混合物密度（kg m⁻³），$e_b$ 为比内能（J kg⁻¹），$\boldsymbol Y$ 为组分质量分数向量（无量纲，各分量之和为一）；EOS 指状态方程。
kind: Ideal-mixture constitutive control and required refinement

notes: Permanent gas remains after condensable vapor is removed
Dense compression requires a calibrated EOS

caption_en: The pressure responds to species masses, temperature, and changing volume.
caption_zh: 压力响应组分质量、温度及体积变化。

tex: \frac{\dot p_{v,s}}{p_{v,s}}=\frac{\dot m_{v,s}}{m_{v,s}}+\frac{\dot T_b}{T_b}-\frac{\dot V_b}{V_b}=\frac{\dot m_{v,s}}{m_{v,s}}+\frac{\dot T_b}{T_b}-3\frac{\dot R}{R}\quad\text{(sphere)}
symbols_en: $p_{v,s}>0$ is species partial pressure (Pa); $m_{v,s}>0$ is its vapor-domain mass (kg), s labeling species; $T_b>0$ is bubble temperature (K); $V_b>0$ is volume (m³); $R>0$ is radius for a spherical bubble (m); a dot is a time derivative. Every ratio has units s⁻¹; the final equality uses $V_b=4\pi R^3/3$ and is restricted to spherical geometry.
symbols_zh: $p_{v,s}>0$ 为组分分压（Pa）；$m_{v,s}>0$ 为其蒸汽域质量（kg），s 表示组分；$T_b>0$ 为气泡温度（K）；$V_b>0$ 为体积（m³）；$R>0$ 为球形气泡半径（m）；上点表示时间导数。各比值单位均为 s⁻¹；最后一个等式使用 $V_b=4\pi R^3/3$，仅限球形几何。

symbols_en: $\boldsymbol u(\boldsymbol x,t)$ is liquid velocity (m s⁻¹), $\boldsymbol x$ position (m), and $t$ time (s). $\nabla$ is the spatial gradient (m⁻¹); superscript $\mathsf T$ transposes a tensor. $\boldsymbol D_u$ is strain-rate tensor (s⁻¹), $\boldsymbol T_l$ liquid Cauchy stress (Pa), $p$ liquid pressure (Pa), $\mu\ge0$ dynamic viscosity (Pa s), and $\boldsymbol I$ the dimensionless identity tensor. $\boldsymbol n_f$ is the unit solid-to-liquid normal; $\boldsymbol t_l$ is traction on the solid (Pa). Subscripts u, l and f label velocity strain, liquid and film surface.
symbols_zh: $\boldsymbol u(\boldsymbol x,t)$为液体速度（m s⁻¹），$\boldsymbol x$为位置（m），$t$为时间（s）。$\nabla$为空间梯度（m⁻¹）；上标$\mathsf T$表示张量转置。$\boldsymbol D_u$为应变率张量（s⁻¹），$\boldsymbol T_l$为液体柯西应力（Pa），$p$为液体压力（Pa），$\mu\ge0$为动力黏度（Pa s），$\boldsymbol I$为无量纲单位张量。$\boldsymbol n_f$为固体指向液体的单位法向；$\boldsymbol t_l$为固体上的牵引（Pa）。下标u、l、f分别标识速度应变、液体及薄膜表面。

notes: Positive opening direction ↑
The release interface is a separate surface.

caption_en: Pressure and shear act at the exposed film face; the drawn normal fixes the traction sign.
caption_zh: 压力与剪切作用于薄膜外露面；所画法向决定牵引符号。

tex: \begin{aligned}\boldsymbol F_l(t)&=\int_{A_f(t)}\boldsymbol t_l\,dA,\\ \boldsymbol I_l&=\int_{t_a}^{t_b}\boldsymbol F_l(t)\,dt,\\ \mathcal W_l&=\int_{t_a}^{t_b}\int_{A_f(t)}\boldsymbol t_l\cdot\boldsymbol v_f\,dA\,dt.\end{aligned}
symbols_en: $A_f(t)$ is the loaded solid surface (m²), $dA$ its surface-area element (m²), and $\int$ denotes integration over the indicated surface or time. $\boldsymbol t_l$ is applied liquid traction (Pa), $\boldsymbol F_l$ its resultant (N), $\boldsymbol I_l$ its impulse (N s), and $\mathcal W_l$ work delivered to the solid (J). $\boldsymbol v_f$ is local solid surface velocity (m s⁻¹). $t_a<t_b$ are event start and end times (s); $t$ and $dt$ are time and its integration element (s). The vector dot product projects force onto velocity. Subscripts l and f label liquid and film.
symbols_zh: $A_f(t)$为固体受载表面（m²），$dA$为表面积微元（m²），$\int$表示对所示表面或时间积分。$\boldsymbol t_l$为液体施加的牵引（Pa），$\boldsymbol F_l$为其合力（N），$\boldsymbol I_l$为其冲量（N s），$\mathcal W_l$为传入固体的功（J）。$\boldsymbol v_f$为固体表面局部速度（m s⁻¹）。$t_a<t_b$为事件起止时间（s）；$t$与$dt$分别为时间及其积分微元（s）。向量点乘将力投影到速度上。下标l和f表示液体与薄膜。

notes: A high pressure maximum does not specify work.

caption_en: The same footprint supplies force and impulse, but surface motion is additionally required for work.
caption_zh: 同一作用范围决定力与冲量，而求功还需要表面运动信息。

symbols_en: $m_A>0$ is film areal mass (kg m⁻²), $D_f>0$ bending stiffness (N m), $\rho_f>0$ constant density (kg m⁻³), $h_f>0$ film thickness (m), $E_f>0$ Young’s modulus (Pa), and $-1<\nu_f<1/2$ Poisson’s ratio (dimensionless). $z$ is thickness coordinate (m), zero at the neutral midplane; $dz$ is its integration element (m). $\int$ is definite thickness integration. Subscripts A and f label areal quantity and film.
symbols_zh: $m_A>0$为薄膜面密度（kg m⁻²），$D_f>0$为弯曲刚度（N m），$\rho_f>0$为恒定密度（kg m⁻³），$h_f>0$为薄膜厚度（m），$E_f>0$为杨氏模量（Pa），$-1<\nu_f<1/2$为泊松比（无量纲）。$z$为厚度坐标（m），中性面处为零；$dz$为其积分微元（m）。$\int$表示沿厚度定积分。下标A与f标识面量与薄膜。
kind: Derived plate parameters under constitutive assumptions

notes: Density integrates once; bending weights distance squared.

caption_en: Areal inertia and bending stiffness come from different thickness integrals.
caption_zh: 面惯性与弯曲刚度来自不同的厚度积分。

symbols_en: $\Omega_f$ is the reference film plane (m²), $dA$ its area element (m²), $w(x,y,t)$ vertical displacement (m), $x,y$ in-plane coordinates (m), and $t$ time (s). A dot differentiates in time; subscripts $xx,yy,xy$ differentiate twice in the indicated coordinates, giving curvatures (m⁻¹). $\nabla_\parallel$ is the in-plane gradient; $|\ |$ denotes Euclidean magnitude. $m_A$ is areal mass (kg m⁻²), $D_f$ bending stiffness (N m), $\nu_f$ Poisson’s ratio, and $T_0\ge0$ prescribed isotropic tensile force per edge length (N m⁻¹). $K_f,U_b,U_T$ are kinetic, bending and pretension energies (J); $\int$ denotes area integration. Labels f, b, T identify film, bending and tension.
symbols_zh: $\Omega_f$为薄膜参考平面（m²），$dA$为面积微元（m²），$w(x,y,t)$为竖直位移（m），$x,y$为面内坐标（m），$t$为时间（s）。上点表示时间导数；下标$xx,yy,xy$表示对所示坐标求二阶导数，得到曲率（m⁻¹）。$\nabla_\parallel$为面内梯度；$|\ |$为欧氏模长。$m_A$为面密度（kg m⁻²），$D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m），$\nu_f$为泊松比，$T_0\ge0$为给定各向同性单位边长拉力（N m⁻¹）。$K_f,U_b,U_T$分别为动能、弯曲能及预张力能（J）；$\int$表示面积积分。标签f、b、T分别指薄膜、弯曲与张力。

notes: Clamped edge: displacement and normal slope fixed.

caption_en: Bending energy is stored by curvature; inertia depends on velocity.
caption_zh: 曲率储存弯曲能，速度决定惯性动能。

symbols_en:
$\Omega_f$ is the smooth reference film plane (m²), $\partial\Omega_f$ its boundary, $dA$ area element (m²), and $d\ell$ boundary arc-length element (m). $w$ is displacement (m); $\delta w$ an admissible infinitesimal variation (m); $\delta U_b,\delta U_T$ the corresponding bending/pretension energy variations (J). $\alpha, eta=1,2$ index the two Cartesian in-plane directions, with $\sum$ summing all four index pairs. $\partial_\alpha$ is coordinate differentiation (m⁻¹); $w_{\alpha eta}=\partial_\alpha\partial_ eta w$ is curvature (m⁻¹). $D_f$ is bending stiffness (N m), $
u_f$ Poisson’s ratio, $T_0$ pretension (N m⁻¹), and $B_{\alpha eta}$ the bending-energy tensor conjugate to curvature (N). $\delta_{\alpha eta}$ is the dimensionless Kronecker identity, distinct from variation notation. $n_\alpha,n_ eta$ are components of the outward in-plane unit boundary normal; $\partial_n$ its derivative. $
abla_\parallel$ and $
abla_\parallel^2$ are in-plane gradient and Laplacian; $ oldsymbol0$ is zero gradient. $\int,\oint$ denote area and closed-boundary integrals. $\Rightarrow$ uses zero tangential derivative of an identically zero boundary variation plus the prescribed zero normal derivative.
symbols_zh:
$\Omega_f$为光滑薄膜参考平面（m²），$\partial\Omega_f$为其边界，$dA$为面积微元（m²），$d\ell$为边界弧长微元（m）。$w$为位移（m）；$\delta w$为容许无穷小变分（m）；$\delta U_b,\delta U_T$为相应弯曲／预张力能变分（J）。$\alpha, eta=1,2$标识两个笛卡尔面内方向，$\sum$对四种指标组合求和。$\partial_\alpha$为坐标求导（m⁻¹）；$w_{\alpha eta}=\partial_\alpha\partial_ eta w$为曲率（m⁻¹）。$D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m），$
u_f$为泊松比，$T_0$为预张力（N m⁻¹），$B_{\alpha eta}$为与曲率共轭的弯曲能张量（N）。$\delta_{\alpha eta}$为无量纲Kronecker单位张量，与变分记号不同。$n_\alpha,n_ eta$为面内边界外单位法向分量；$\partial_n$为沿该法向求导。$
abla_\parallel$及$
abla_\parallel^2$为面内梯度及拉普拉斯算子；$ oldsymbol0$为零梯度。$\int,\oint$分别表示面积积分与闭合边界积分。$\Rightarrow$使用恒为零的边界变分具有零切向导数，并结合给定零法向导数。

notes: The first bending boundary term contains the slope variation.
The second contains the displacement variation; both vanish at the clamp.

caption_en: Two integrations by parts expose the boundary moment and shear terms before they are removed.
caption_zh: 两次分部积分先明确显示边界弯矩与剪力项，再依据条件将其消去。

symbols_en:
$\delta$ denotes an infinitesimal admissible variation, not physical crack opening here; $\delta w$ is a displacement variation (m). $U_b,U_T$ are bending and pretension energy (J); $D_f$ is bending stiffness (N m); $
u_f$ is dimensionless Poisson’s ratio; $T_0$ is uniform pretension (N m⁻¹). $w$ is transverse displacement (m); $x,y$ are in-plane coordinates (m). Subscripts $xxxx,xxyy,yyyy$ denote the indicated fourth derivatives (m⁻³). $
abla_\parallel^2=\partial_x^2+\partial_y^2$ is the in-plane Laplacian; $
abla_\parallel^4$ is that Laplacian applied twice. $\Omega_f$ is film area (m²); $dA$ is its element (m²); $\int$ is area integration. The variations and their normal slopes vanish at a clamped boundary.
symbols_zh:
$\delta$在此表示无穷小容许变分，而非物理裂纹张开；$\delta w$为位移变分（m）。$U_b,U_T$为弯曲能及预张力能（J）；$D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m）；$
u_f$为无量纲泊松比；$T_0$为均匀预张力（N m⁻¹）。$w$为横向位移（m）；$x,y$为面内坐标（m）。下标$xxxx,xxyy,yyyy$表示所示四阶导数（m⁻³）。$
abla_\parallel^2=\partial_x^2+\partial_y^2$为面内拉普拉斯算子；$
abla_\parallel^4$为将该算子作用两次。$\Omega_f$为薄膜面积（m²）；$dA$为面积微元（m²）；$\int$表示面积积分。夹持边界处变分及其法向斜率均为零。
kind: Derived variational identity for fixed clamps

notes: Four spatial derivatives arise from two integrations by parts.

caption_en: A fixed clamp removes the boundary virtual-work terms.
caption_zh: 固定夹持边界使边界虚功项消失。

tex: \begin{aligned}m_A\ddot w+D_f\nabla_\parallel^4w-T_0\nabla_\parallel^2w&=p_{\rm load}-t_{\rm coh},\\w(\boldsymbol x,0)=0,\quad\dot w(\boldsymbol x,0)&=0,\\w=0,\quad\partial_n w&=0\quad\text{on a clamped edge}.\end{aligned}
symbols_en: $w(\boldsymbol x,t)$ is film displacement in the positive departure direction (m); $\boldsymbol x=(x,y)$ is in-plane position (m), and $t$ time (s). $\dot w,\ddot w$ are time derivatives (m s⁻¹, m s⁻²). $m_A$ is areal mass (kg m⁻²), $D_f$ bending stiffness (N m), and $T_0\ge0$ pretension (N m⁻¹). $\nabla_\parallel^2$ is in-plane Laplacian (m⁻²), and $\nabla_\parallel^4$ its square. $p_{\rm load}$ is net applied transverse traction projected positively (Pa), whereas $t_{\rm coh}\ge0$ is an opening-resisting cohesive traction magnitude (Pa). $\partial_n$ differentiates along the outward in-plane boundary normal. Initial zero is displacement or velocity according to its row. Labels load and coh identify applied and cohesive forces.
symbols_zh: $w(\boldsymbol x,t)$为沿正离开方向的薄膜位移（m）；$\boldsymbol x=(x,y)$为面内位置（m），$t$为时间（s）。$\dot w,\ddot w$为时间导数（m s⁻¹、m s⁻²）。$m_A$为面密度（kg m⁻²），$D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m），$T_0\ge0$为预张力（N m⁻¹）。$\nabla_\parallel^2$为面内拉普拉斯算子（m⁻²），$\nabla_\parallel^4$为其平方。$p_{\rm load}$为沿正方向投影的净外加横向牵引（Pa），$t_{\rm coh}\ge0$为抵抗张开的内聚牵引幅值（Pa）。$\partial_n$表示沿面内边界外法向求导。初始零值按对应行分别表示位移或速度。标签load和coh表示外载与内聚力。
kind: Reduced transient momentum balance with explicit initial/boundary data

notes: The film starts at rest.
The release interface supplies resistance.

caption_en: Film acceleration balances applied traction, elastic restoring forces and cohesive resistance.
caption_zh: 薄膜加速度由外加牵引、弹性恢复力与内聚阻力的平衡决定。

tex: \begin{aligned}\int_{\Omega_f}m_A\ddot w\dot w\,dA&=\frac{dK_f}{dt},\qquad \int_{\Omega_f}D_f\nabla_\parallel^4w\dot w\,dA=\frac{dU_b}{dt},\\-\int_{\Omega_f}T_0\nabla_\parallel^2w\dot w\,dA&=\frac{dU_T}{dt},\\\frac{d}{dt}(K_f+U_b+U_T)&=\int_{\Omega_f}p_{\rm load}\dot w\,dA-\int_{\Omega_f}t_{\rm coh}\dot w\,dA.\end{aligned}
symbols_en: $\Omega_f$ is reference film area (m²), $dA$ its area element (m²), $w$ displacement (m), and $\dot w,\ddot w$ velocity and acceleration (m s⁻¹, m s⁻²). $m_A$ is areal mass (kg m⁻²), $D_f$ bending stiffness (N m), $T_0$ constant pretension (N m⁻¹), $p_{\rm load}$ applied transverse traction (Pa), and $t_{\rm coh}$ resisting cohesive traction (Pa). $K_f,U_b,U_T$ are kinetic, bending and pretension energies (J); $t$ is time (s); $d/dt$ is its derivative. $\nabla_\parallel^2$ is planar Laplacian and $\nabla_\parallel^4$ its square; $\int$ is area integration. The derivatives are valid for the stated constant parameters and sufficiently regular fields at a fixed clamp with zero velocity and normal velocity slope. Every row has power units W; f, b, T, load and coh label film, bending, tension, applied and cohesive.
symbols_zh: $\Omega_f$为薄膜参考面积（m²），$dA$为面积微元（m²），$w$为位移（m），$\dot w,\ddot w$为速度及加速度（m s⁻¹、m s⁻²）。$m_A$为面密度（kg m⁻²），$D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m），$T_0$为恒定预张力（N m⁻¹），$p_{\rm load}$为外加横向牵引（Pa），$t_{\rm coh}$为抵抗内聚牵引（Pa）。$K_f,U_b,U_T$为动能、弯曲能及预张力能（J）；$t$为时间（s）；$d/dt$为时间导数。$\nabla_\parallel^2$为平面拉普拉斯算子，$\nabla_\parallel^4$为其平方；$\int$表示面积积分。导数适用于所述恒定参数、足够正则的场，以及速度和法向速度斜率均为零的固定夹持边界。各行单位均为功率W；f、b、T、load、coh分别表示薄膜、弯曲、张力、外加及内聚。
kind: Transient plate power identity under fixed clamps

notes: Fixed clamps perform no boundary work.
Recoverable cohesion and fracture loss must be counted once.

caption_en: The transient plate equation conserves power between applied work, motion, shape and interface response.
caption_zh: 瞬态薄板方程在外加功、运动、形状与界面响应之间保持功率守恒。

symbols_en: $w_P,w$ are PVC and film displacements in the same positive direction (m); double dots are accelerations (m s⁻²). $m_{A,P},m_A$ are their areal masses (kg m⁻²); $D_P,D_f$ their bending stiffnesses (N m); $T_P,T_0$ their prescribed pretensions (N m⁻¹). $\nabla_\parallel^2$ is the in-plane Laplacian and $\nabla_\parallel^4$ its square. $p_{\rm liq}$ is net liquid traction on PVC (Pa), $t_{P\to f}$ transmitted PVC-to-film traction projected positively (Pa), and $t_{\rm coh}$ film-release resistance (Pa). P labels PVC, f film, A areal, liq liquid and coh cohesion; the arrow labels the transmission direction. Each sheet has its actual initial and support conditions. No value of transmitted traction is supplied without an additional contact/bond closure.
symbols_zh: $w_P,w$为PVC与薄膜沿同一正方向的位移（m）；双上点为加速度（m s⁻²）。$m_{A,P},m_A$为两者面密度（kg m⁻²）；$D_P,D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m）；$T_P,T_0$为给定预张力（N m⁻¹）。$\nabla_\parallel^2$为面内拉普拉斯算子，$\nabla_\parallel^4$为其平方。$p_{\rm liq}$为液体作用于PVC的净牵引（Pa），$t_{P\to f}$为沿正方向投影的PVC传向薄膜牵引（Pa），$t_{\rm coh}$为薄膜释放阻力（Pa）。P表示PVC，f表示薄膜，A表示面量，liq表示液体，coh表示内聚；箭头标识传递方向。每层均具有自身实际初始及支承条件。若无附加接触／粘接闭合关系，传递牵引就尚未确定。

labels: w_P, m_A,P, D_P, T_P — PVC response
w, m_A, D_f, T₀ — film response
notes: No liquid passes through intact PVC.
Transmitted traction is an unknown, not a copied pressure.

caption_en: The PVC-to-film load follows intermediate-sheet motion and contact.
caption_zh: PVC传向薄膜的载荷由中间片层运动与接触决定。

tex: m_A[\dot w(\boldsymbol x,t_b)-\dot w(\boldsymbol x,t_a)]=J_A-\int_{t_a}^{t_b}[D_f\nabla_\parallel^4w-T_0\nabla_\parallel^2w+t_{\rm coh}]\,dt,\qquad J_A=\int_{t_a}^{t_b}p_{\rm load}\,dt
symbols_en: $m_A$ is film areal mass (kg m⁻²), $w(\boldsymbol x,t)$ vertical displacement (m), $\boldsymbol x$ in-plane position (m), and $\dot w$ velocity (m s⁻¹). $t_a,t_b,t,dt$ are pulse endpoints, integration time and time element (s). $J_A$ is local applied impulse per area (Pa s), $p_{\rm load}$ net applied traction (Pa), $t_{\rm coh}$ cohesive resistance (Pa), $D_f$ bending stiffness (N m), and $T_0$ pretension (N m⁻¹). $\nabla_\parallel^2$ and $\nabla_\parallel^4$ are the in-plane Laplacian and its square. $\int$ integrates the actual local load/response during the pulse. Labels A, f, load and coh mean areal, film, applied and cohesive.
symbols_zh: $m_A$为薄膜面密度（kg m⁻²），$w(\boldsymbol x,t)$为竖直位移（m），$\boldsymbol x$为面内位置（m），$\dot w$为速度（m s⁻¹）。$t_a,t_b,t,dt$分别为脉冲起止时刻、积分时间及时间微元（s）。$J_A$为局部单位面积外加冲量（Pa s），$p_{\rm load}$为净外加牵引（Pa），$t_{\rm coh}$为内聚阻力（Pa），$D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m），$T_0$为预张力（N m⁻¹）。$\nabla_\parallel^2$与$\nabla_\parallel^4$为面内拉普拉斯算子及其平方。$\int$表示对脉冲期间实际局部载荷／响应积分。标签A、f、load、coh分别表示面量、薄膜、外加及内聚。
kind: Exact time integral within the reduced plate model

notes: Applied impulse and reaction impulse both enter.

caption_en: Pulse integration exposes the reactions that can invalidate a free velocity jump.
caption_zh: 脉冲积分明确显示哪些反作用冲量会使自由速度跃变失效。

symbols_en: $\Delta\dot w$ is the film velocity change from rest (m s⁻¹); $\Delta$ denotes final-minus-initial difference, and a dot is a time derivative. $J_A$ is local applied impulse per area (Pa s), $m_A>0$ film areal mass (kg m⁻²), and $\mathcal E_A$ resulting kinetic energy per area (J m⁻²). $\simeq$ marks negligible restoring/cohesive impulse during the pulse, not guaranteed transmission through an adhered stack. Subscript A labels quantities per area.
symbols_zh: $\Delta\dot w$为薄膜从静止开始的速度变化（m s⁻¹）；$\Delta$表示终值减初值，上点为时间导数。$J_A$为局部单位面积外加冲量（Pa s），$m_A>0$为薄膜面密度（kg m⁻²），$\mathcal E_A$为所得单位面积动能（J m⁻²）。$\simeq$表示脉冲期间恢复力／内聚力冲量可忽略，而非保证粘接叠层中的载荷传递。下标A表示单位面积量。

notes: Reaction impulses must be negligible.

caption_en: Impulse creates film kinetic energy that may subsequently feed deformation and fracture.
caption_zh: 冲量产生薄膜动能，之后才可能转入变形与断裂。

tex: t_b^{\rm scale}=a_f^2\sqrt{\frac{m_A}{D_f}},\qquad t_T^{\rm scale}=a_f\sqrt{\frac{m_A}{T_0}},\qquad t_n^{\rm scale}=\sqrt{\frac{m_A}{K_n}}
symbols_en: $t_b^{\rm scale},t_T^{\rm scale},t_n^{\rm scale}$ are bending, pretension and normal-cohesion response scales (s), not exact modal periods; superscript scale labels estimates and subscripts b, T, n identify the restoring mechanisms. $a_f>0$ is lateral deformation length (m), $m_A>0$ areal mass (kg m⁻²), $D_f>0$ bending stiffness (N m), $T_0>0$ pretension (N m⁻¹), and $K_n>0$ small-opening normal cohesive stiffness (Pa m⁻¹). $\sqrt{\ }$ is the positive root. If pretension or cohesion is absent, its corresponding timescale is omitted rather than divided by zero.
symbols_zh: $t_b^{\rm scale},t_T^{\rm scale},t_n^{\rm scale}$分别为弯曲、预张力及法向内聚响应尺度（s），而非精确模态周期；上标scale表示估计，下标b、T、n标识恢复机制。$a_f>0$为横向变形长度（m），$m_A>0$为面密度（kg m⁻²），$D_f>0$为弯曲刚度（N m），$T_0>0$为预张力（N m⁻¹），$K_n>0$为小张开法向内聚刚度（Pa m⁻¹）。$\sqrt{\ }$取正根。若预张力或内聚机制不存在，则不使用对应时间尺度，不能除以零。

notes: PVC also has a finite through-thickness wave time.

caption_en: Pulse duration must be compared with the response scales of the actual load path.
caption_zh: 脉冲持续时间须与实际传力路径的响应尺度比较。

symbols_en: $G$ is quasistatic energy-release rate (J m⁻²), $\mathcal P$ total mechanical potential including the external loading system (J), $A_c$ crack area (m²), and $\partial/\partial A_c$ a partial derivative. $\mathcal C$ labels the held loading control, such as pressure or displacement; it is not a material coefficient. $\Gamma$ is fracture resistance (J m⁻²), $\psi$ mode-mixture parameter (dimensionless), $T_i$ interface temperature (K), and $v_c$ crack-front speed (m s⁻¹). Subscripts c and i label crack and interface. The inequality is an energetic propagation criterion for the specified fracture model, not a sufficient transfer criterion.
symbols_zh: $G$为准静态能量释放率（J m⁻²），$\mathcal P$为包含外部加载系统的总力学势能（J），$A_c$为裂纹面积（m²），$\partial/\partial A_c$为偏导数。$\mathcal C$标识保持不变的加载控制量，例如压力或位移，而非材料系数。$\Gamma$为断裂阻力（J m⁻²），$\psi$为模态混合参数（无量纲），$T_i$为界面温度（K），$v_c$为裂纹前沿速度（m s⁻¹）。下标c与i表示裂纹及界面。此不等式是指定断裂模型的能量扩展判据，而非充分转印判据。

labels: G → available energy per new area
notes: Strength has units Pa; fracture resistance has units J/m².

caption_en: A crack is driven by energy per newly separated area, under a specified load control.
caption_zh: 裂纹由每单位新分离面积的可用能量驱动，且加载控制必须明确。

symbols_en: $P_{\rm load}$ is mechanical power delivered to the solid (W), $K_f$ its kinetic energy (J), $U_f$ its recoverable elastic energy including any recoverable interface energy (J), and $d/dt$ the time derivative with $t$ in s. $\mathcal L_c$ is the active crack-front line; $d\ell$ is its arc-length element (m). $v_c\ge0$ is front speed (m s⁻¹), $\Gamma$ fracture energy (J m⁻²), $\psi$ dimensionless mode mixture, and $T_i$ interface temperature (K). $P_{\rm other}\ge0$ is additional nonfracture dissipation (W). $\int$ integrates along the front. Labels load, f, c, i and other denote applied, solid film, crack, interface and remaining dissipative processes.
symbols_zh: $P_{\rm load}$为传入固体的力学功率（W），$K_f$为固体动能（J），$U_f$为可恢复弹性能，含任何可恢复界面能（J），$d/dt$为时间导数，$t$单位s。$\mathcal L_c$为活跃裂纹前沿曲线；$d\ell$为弧长微元（m）。$v_c\ge0$为前沿速度（m s⁻¹），$\Gamma$为断裂能（J m⁻²），$\psi$为无量纲模态混合参数，$T_i$为界面温度（K）。$P_{\rm other}\ge0$为其他非断裂耗散（W）。$\int$表示沿前沿积分。标签load、f、c、i、other分别表示外加、固体薄膜、裂纹、界面及其余耗散过程。

labels: L_c, dℓ, v_c → new crack area/time
notes: Crack dissipation is counted once.

caption_en: Dynamic loading can store kinetic energy before or during crack advance.
caption_zh: 动态载荷可在裂纹扩展前或扩展中储存动能。

tex: \mathscr L_rg=\frac{p_0}{D_f},\qquad g=\mathscr L_rw,\qquad \mathscr L_r f=\frac1r\frac{d}{dr}\left(r\frac{df}{dr}\right),\qquad w(b)=0,\quad w^{\prime}(b)=0

Labels r, f and 0 denote radial operator, film/arbitrary function according to context, and maintained load. The two zero values prescribe edge displacement and slope.
symbols_zh: $r\in[0,b]$为板平面内半径（m），$b>0$为脱层半径（m），$w(r)$为张开位移（m），$p_0>0$为外部保持的压差（Pa），$D_f>0$为弯曲刚度（N m）。$\mathscr L_r$为轴对称平面拉普拉斯算子（m⁻²）；$f$为任意光滑径向函数，$g=\mathscr L_rw$的单位为m⁻¹。$d/dr$及撇号表示径向求导；$r=0$处算子取正则极限。标签r、f、0分别表示径向算子、薄膜／任意函数（依语境）及恒定载荷。两个零值指定边缘位移与斜率。

notes: No point force at the centre.
External pressure remains fixed as b changes.

caption_en: Uniform pressure loads a clamped circular delamination with regular central fields.
caption_zh: 均匀压力作用于边缘夹持的圆形脱层，中心场必须正则。

symbols_en: $r\in(0,b]$ is radial coordinate (m); $b$ is delamination radius (m). $g(r)=\mathscr L_rw$ is the curvature sum (m⁻¹), with a prime and $d/dr$ denoting radial differentiation. $p_0$ is maintained pressure difference (Pa); $D_f$ bending stiffness (N m). $C_1,C_2$ are integration constants with units m⁻¹. $C_1=0$ follows from regular central curvature gradient and absence of a point load. $\mathscr L_r$ is the radial Laplacian, $w$ displacement (m); the subscript 0 labels the maintained pressure, not the initial liquid pressure.
symbols_zh: $r\in(0,b]$为径向坐标（m）；$b$为脱层半径（m）。$g(r)=\mathscr L_rw$为曲率和（m⁻¹），撇号及$d/dr$表示径向求导。$p_0$为恒定压差（Pa）；$D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m）。$C_1,C_2$为单位m⁻¹的积分常数。$C_1=0$来自中心曲率梯度正则及无点载荷条件。$\mathscr L_r$为径向拉普拉斯算子，$w$为位移（m）；下标0标识恒定压力，而非液体初始压力。

notes: An inverse-radius curvature gradient is rejected at the centre.

caption_en: Regularity removes the singular integration constant before edge conditions are used.
caption_zh: 在使用边缘条件之前，正则性先排除奇异积分常数。

symbols_en: $r\in(0,b]$ is radial position (m), $b$ delamination radius (m), $w$ displacement (m), and $g$ curvature sum (m⁻¹). A prime and $d/dr$ are radial derivatives; $w^{\prime}$ is dimensionless slope. $p_0$ is maintained pressure (Pa), $D_f$ bending stiffness (N m), $C_2$ curvature integration constant (m⁻¹), and $C_3,C_4$ displacement integration constants (m). $C_3=0$ excludes a central inverse-radius slope. All rows are regular-limit solutions at the centre. Subscripts 2,3,4 index distinct constants, not derivative orders.

kind: Derived second pair of radial integrations

notes: The centre carries no singular force.

caption_en: The regular displacement contains quartic, quadratic and constant contributions.
caption_zh: 正则位移含四次项、二次项与常数项。

symbols_en: $w(r)$ is displacement (m), $w^{\prime}$ radial slope, $r\in[0,b]$ radial position (m), and $b>0$ delamination radius (m), allowing division by $b$. $p_0>0$ is maintained pressure (Pa), $D_f>0$ bending stiffness (N m), $C_2$ curvature constant (m⁻¹), and $C_4$ displacement constant (m). The prime denotes $d/dr$; $\Rightarrow$ denotes the algebraic consequence of each clamped boundary condition. Subscripts 2 and 4 label constants, and f labels film.
symbols_zh: $w(r)$为位移（m），$w^{\prime}$为径向斜率，$r\in[0,b]$为径向位置（m），$b>0$为脱层半径（m），因此可以除以$b$。$p_0>0$为恒定压力（Pa），$D_f>0$为弯曲刚度（N m），$C_2$为曲率常数（m⁻¹），$C_4$为位移常数（m）。撇号表示$d/dr$；$\Rightarrow$表示各夹持边界条件的代数结果。下标2与4标识常数，f表示薄膜。
kind: Exact solution of the stated linear-plate benchmark

notes: The bonded outside region supplies the clamp.

caption_en: Applying both edge conditions fixes the unique regular blister profile.
caption_zh: 同时应用两个边缘条件，确定唯一正则鼓泡轮廓。

symbols_en: $\mathscr L_r$ is the radial planar Laplacian (m⁻²), and superscript 2 on the operator means composition twice; superscripts on $r$ are powers. $r$ is radial position (m), $b$ delamination radius (m), $w$ blister displacement (m), and its prime is radial slope. $D_f$ is bending stiffness (N m); $p_0$ maintained pressure (Pa). Literal 4 and 16 are numerical coefficients; $\mathscr L_r(r^2)$ is dimensionless and $\mathscr L_r(r^4)$ has units m². The slope expression vanishes at $r=0$ and $r=b$.
symbols_zh: $\mathscr L_r$为径向平面拉普拉斯算子（m⁻²），算子上的上标2表示连续作用两次；$r$上的上标表示幂。$r$为径向位置（m），$b$为脱层半径（m），$w$为鼓泡位移（m），其撇号为径向斜率。$D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m）；$p_0$为恒定压力（Pa）。数字4与16是数值系数；$\mathscr L_r(r^2)$无量纲，$\mathscr L_r(r^4)$单位为m²。斜率式在$r=0$及$r=b$均为零。

notes: L_r r² = 4
L_r r⁴ = 16r²

caption_en: Direct radial differentiation verifies the pressure balance and regular clamped profile.
caption_zh: 直接径向求导可检验压力平衡及正则夹持轮廓。

symbols_en: $V_{\rm bl}$ is added blister volume (m³), $w(r)$ displacement (m), $r\in[0,b]$ radial integration coordinate (m), $dr$ its integration element (m), and $b$ delamination radius (m). $p_0$ is maintained pressure (Pa); $D_f$ bending stiffness (N m); $\pi$ the dimensionless circle constant. $\int$ is radial integration, and $[\ ]_0^b$ denotes antiderivative at the upper endpoint minus its value at zero. Subscript bl labels the blister; superscripts on lengths are powers.
symbols_zh: $V_{\rm bl}$为新增鼓泡体积（m³），$w(r)$为位移（m），$r\in[0,b]$为径向积分坐标（m），$dr$为积分微元（m），$b$为脱层半径（m）。$p_0$为恒定压力（Pa）；$D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m）；$\pi$为无量纲圆周率。$\int$表示径向积分，$[\ ]_0^b$表示原函数在上端点的值减去其零端点值。下标bl表示鼓泡；长度上的上标均表示幂。
kind: Exact geometric volume integral for the benchmark

notes: Every annulus contributes its own displacement.

caption_en: Blister volume sums the opening of all concentric annuli.
caption_zh: 鼓泡体积等于各同心圆环张开贡献之和。

tex: C_b=\left.\frac{\partial V_{\rm bl}}{\partial p_0}\right|_b=\frac{\pi b^6}{192D_f},\qquad V_{\rm bl}=C_bp_0,\qquad U_b=\int_0^{V_{\rm bl}}\frac{v}{C_b}\,dv=\frac{V_{\rm bl}^2}{2C_b}=\frac{p_0V_{\rm bl}}2,\qquad \mathcal P=U_b-p_0V_{\rm bl}=-\frac{\pi p_0^2b^6}{384D_f}
symbols_en: $C_b>0$ is blister volume compliance (m³ Pa⁻¹), defined by the pressure derivative at fixed radius, including the regular zero-load value. $V_{\rm bl}\ge0$ is added volume (m³), $p_0\ge0$ maintained pressure (Pa), $b>0$ crack radius (m), and $D_f>0$ bending stiffness (N m). $\partial/\partial p_0$ is the pressure derivative; the vertical bar holds radius fixed. $U_b$ is stored plate bending energy (J), $\mathcal P$ plate-plus-pressure-reservoir potential (J), and $v$ a dummy volume along the fixed-radius elastic loading curve (m³), with $dv$ its element (m³). $\int$ integrates that loading curve. Subscripts b and bl label blister compliance/bending and blister volume, respectively; the meanings are explicitly fixed here. No crack-area variation is taken during the loading-curve integral. For positive pressure, compliance also equals volume divided by pressure; at zero pressure the derivative avoids division by zero.
symbols_zh: $C_b>0$为鼓泡体积柔度（m³ Pa⁻¹），由固定半径下的压力导数定义，包含正则零载荷值。$V_{\rm bl}\ge0$为新增体积（m³），$p_0\ge0$为恒定压力（Pa），$b>0$为裂纹半径（m），$D_f>0$为弯曲刚度（N m）。$\partial/\partial p_0$为压力导数；竖线表示保持半径不变。$U_b$为板弯曲储能（J），$\mathcal P$为板与恒压储库的总势能（J），$v$为固定半径弹性加载曲线上的虚拟体积变量（m³），$dv$为其微元（m³）。$\int$表示该加载曲线积分。下标b与bl分别表示鼓泡柔度／弯曲及鼓泡体积，此处已明确其含义。在加载曲线积分过程中不改变裂纹面积。正压力时，柔度也等于体积除以压力；零压力时采用导数避免除以零。

notes: The external pressure reservoir supplies work as the crack grows.

caption_en: Source work changes the sign of the relevant total potential.
caption_zh: 压力源做功改变相关总势能的符号。

symbols_en: $A_c$ is delaminated area (m²), $b>0$ its radius (m), $\pi$ the circle constant, $\mathcal P$ total potential including maintained pressure (J), $p_0$ fixed pressure difference (Pa), and $D_f$ bending stiffness (N m). $d/db$ differentiates in radius; the vertical bar and subscript $p_0$ indicate held pressure. $G_{p_0}$ is energy-release rate under that control (J m⁻²). Subscript c labels crack area; all length superscripts are powers. Positive $b$ makes the area derivative nonzero.
symbols_zh: $A_c$为脱层面积（m²），$b>0$为其半径（m），$\pi$为圆周率，$\mathcal P$为包含恒压源的总势能（J），$p_0$为固定压差（Pa），$D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m）。$d/db$表示按半径求导；竖线及下标$p_0$表示保持压力不变。$G_{p_0}$为该控制方式下的能量释放率（J m⁻²）。下标c表示裂纹面积；长度上的上标均为幂。$b$为正保证面积导数非零。

notes: The derivative is taken at fixed pressure.

caption_en: Geometry and compliance convert pressure into fracture energy per area.
caption_zh: 几何与柔度将压力转换为单位面积断裂能。

symbols_en: $p_{0,\rm crit}>0$ is critical maintained pressure (Pa) for constant fracture resistance $\Gamma>0$ (J m⁻²); $D_f>0$ is bending stiffness (N m), $b>0$ delamination radius (m), $p_0\ge0$ applied maintained pressure (Pa), and $G_{p_0}$ the corresponding energy-release rate (J m⁻²). $\sqrt{\ }$ is the positive root; subscript crit labels the onset threshold. The quotient $G_{p_0}/\Gamma$ is dimensionless. This onset criterion assumes an existing crack and the quasistatic bending model.
symbols_zh: $p_{0,\rm crit}>0$为恒定断裂阻力$\Gamma>0$（J m⁻²）对应的临界恒压（Pa）；$D_f>0$为弯曲刚度（N m），$b>0$为脱层半径（m），$p_0\ge0$为外加恒压（Pa），$G_{p_0}$为相应能量释放率（J m⁻²）。$\sqrt{\ }$取正根；下标crit表示起始阈值。比值$G_{p_0}/\Gamma$无量纲。此起始判据假设存在预裂纹，并采用准静态弯曲模型。
kind: Derived onset threshold within the benchmark

labels: D_f, Γ → stiffness and fracture resistance
notes: Larger existing delamination lowers critical pressure.

caption_en: The pressure threshold depends on crack geometry and fracture resistance, not pressure alone.
caption_zh: 压力阈值取决于裂纹几何及断裂阻力，而非压力本身。

tex: \begin{aligned}U_b\big|_{\bar V}&=\frac{\bar V^2}{2C_b}=\frac{96D_f\bar V^2}{\pi b^6},\qquad p(b)=\frac{192D_f\bar V}{\pi b^6},\\G_{\bar V}&=-\frac{dU_b/db}{2\pi b}=\frac{288D_f\bar V^2}{\pi^2b^8}=\frac{p(b)^2b^4}{128D_f},\\G_{p_0}&\propto b^4\ \text{at fixed }p_0,\qquad G_{\bar V}\propto b^{-8}\ \text{at fixed }\bar V.\end{aligned}
symbols_en: $\bar V>0$ is imposed fixed added volume (m³), $U_b$ plate bending energy (J), $C_b$ volume compliance (m³ Pa⁻¹), $D_f$ bending stiffness (N m), $b>0$ crack radius (m), and $p(b)$ the pressure required at that radius (Pa). $G_{\bar V}$ and $G_{p_0}$ are energy-release rates under fixed volume and fixed pressure, respectively (J m⁻²); $p_0$ is maintained pressure (Pa). $d/db$ is radius differentiation holding $\bar V$ fixed, $\pi$ the circle constant, and $\propto$ means proportional at fixed other parameters. The bar labels controlled volume, not averaging. The fixed-volume system here supplies no additional pressure-source work.
symbols_zh: $\bar V>0$为强制固定的新增体积（m³），$U_b$为板弯曲能（J），$C_b$为体积柔度（m³ Pa⁻¹），$D_f$为弯曲刚度（N m），$b>0$为裂纹半径（m），$p(b)$为该半径处所需压力（Pa）。$G_{\bar V}$与$G_{p_0}$分别为恒容及恒压控制下的能量释放率（J m⁻²）；$p_0$为恒定压力（Pa）。$d/db$表示保持$\bar V$不变的半径求导，$\pi$为圆周率，$\propto$表示其他参数固定时成正比。横线标识受控体积，而非平均。此恒容系统不再提供额外压力源功。

notes: Same instantaneous state does not imply the same crack trajectory.

caption_en: Fixed pressure and fixed volume lead to opposite changes in driving force as the crack grows.
caption_zh: 裂纹扩展时，恒压与恒容控制使驱动力发生相反变化。

symbols_en: $D_f$ is film bending stiffness (N m) and $p_{0,\rm crit}$ the positive critical maintained pressure (Pa). The substituted teaching Young’s modulus is 2.00×10⁹ Pa, thickness 10.0×10⁻⁶ m, Poisson’s ratio 0.35, crack radius 100×10⁻⁶ m, and fracture resistance 0.10 J m⁻². Pa, N, m, J and kPa denote pascal, newton, metre, joule and kilopascal. $\sqrt{\ }$ is the positive root; superscripts are powers. Subscript f labels the film and crit the onset threshold.
symbols_zh: $D_f$为薄膜弯曲刚度（N m），$p_{0,\rm crit}$为正临界恒压（Pa）。代入的教学杨氏模量为2.00×10⁹ Pa，厚度10.0×10⁻⁶ m，泊松比0.35，裂纹半径100×10⁻⁶ m，断裂阻力0.10 J m⁻²。Pa、N、m、J及kPa分别为帕、牛顿、米、焦耳及千帕。$\sqrt{\ }$取正根；上标表示幂。下标f表示薄膜，crit表示起始阈值。

notes: This is not the 1 μm array-loaded payload.

caption_en: The stated plate and interface yield a conditional 156 kPa maintained-pressure threshold.
caption_zh: 所给薄板与界面产生约156 kPa的条件性恒压阈值。

Subscript edge labels its outer-surface value at the clamped edge; r labels radial direction. $|\ |$ denotes magnitude, $\pi$ the circle constant; μm and MPa are micrometre and megapascal. symbols_zh: $w(0)$为中心位移（m），$h_f=10$ μm为厚度（m），$b=100$ μm为裂纹半径（m），$D_f=1.899335$×10⁻⁷ N m为弯曲刚度，$p_{0,\rm crit}=155.921$ kPa为恒压阈值。$V_{\rm bl}$为鼓泡体积（m³），$M_r(b)$为单位边长径向弯矩（N），$\sigma_{rr}$为径向法向弯曲应力（Pa）。下标edge表示夹持边缘厚度外表面的值；r表示径向。$|\ |$表示幅值，$\pi$为圆周率；μm与MPa分别为微米及兆帕。应力结果采用相同线性各向同性薄板假设。
